summary: Show the carrier of each replication peer's last successful and last failed exchange

replay.detail: Exchange carrier evidence stays host-local in memory and never becomes a replicated claim.

schema.detail: No database, claim registry or checkpoint schema changes.

rules.detail: Route selection and retry rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Add optional last_successful_exchange and last_failed_exchange records to replication/fleet status and client SyncPeer. Each describes the last locally initiated exchange or attempt of that outcome, with its original timestamp and carrier; Fabric route is unknown until per-dial evidence exists. Older clients ignore these fields, older servers omit them, and incoming receipt preserves the prior outbound carrier record; an inbound-only peer has no carrier record (unknown/unavailable evidence). Client schema and generated clients are updated.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated interruption is required.

recovery.detail: Restart clears the two carrier observations per peer; durable last-seen state is unchanged.
